title: GraphQL DataLoader
description: Solve the N+1 problem using DataLoader with request-level batching and caching for efficient data loading.

steps.title: Query posts with authors
steps.description: Create a query { posts { title author { name } } } that returns posts with their authors.
hints: Define Post and User types with author relation
Store users and posts in memory
The author resolver looks up the user by authorId

steps.title: Batch loading with DataLoader
steps.description: Use DataLoader to batch-load authors. Add GET /batch-stats to verify the batch count (number of batch queries made).
hints: Create a DataLoader that batches author lookups by IDs
Track the number of batch calls made
Expose batch stats via a REST endpoint

steps.title: N+1 problem solved
steps.description: Without DataLoader, loading N posts makes N+1 queries (1 for posts, N for authors). With DataLoader, a single batch query loads all N authors at once.
hints: Without DataLoader, each author lookup is an individual query
DataLoader batches all author IDs into one batch request
Verify batch count is 1 (one batch for all authors)

steps.title: Request-level caching
steps.description: Ensure that the same author is not loaded twice within a single request. DataLoader caches by key within the same request context.
hints: DataLoader caches values for the duration of the request
If two posts have the same authorId, only one load call is made
Verify via batch-stats that batch count remains 1 even with duplicate authorId
